goal: Modernized root USB OTG enabler app with high-SDK support (API 35/37) and universal multi-strategy OTG kernel sysfs/SoC driver engine
decisions_made: Targeting modern Android SDK (minSdk 26, targetSdk 37, compileSdk 37) to eliminate 'SDK version too low' install errors on modern devices

Multi-strategy root engine covering Transsion/Infinix/Tecno (/sys/devices/platform/tran_battery/OTG_CTL), MediaTek power_supply/usb/otg_switch, dual_role_usb DFP mode, modern usb_role host mode, Type-C port manager (TCPM/UCSI), Qualcomm/DWC3/Chipidea host registers, OEM system properties (persist.sys.oem.otg_support), and dynamic sysfs node auto-discovery
